title: Stage 0 + S08
body: pooled LightGBM residuals, station levels; S08 split-local LightGBM on pseudo- targets

title: Physical stages
body: common-mode shock, class hedge, log-flow kriging, projection to the published FD

title: Stage 2
body: LightGBM residuals on speed and flow, then the FD projection

title: B6 blend
body: U-Net members blended with the stack per corridor (March fit also serves April)

title: Late stages
body: polish; stage 3 (S7b +60 own-month trees); occupancy; flow-only stage 4

title: Gap rows + clip
body: 90-min blackouts around Task 2 windows; speed ≤ 1.15 x free speed

title: Label sources of the scored month
body: own view: released cells hidden to make labels; official view: every released cell (18.4% the own view never showed); INEL: released, ineligible, never scored (labels only, never inputs)

title: B6 U-Net members, per month
body: 3 seeds x 10 corridors; own view 48k it, ramp and occupancy channels; FV-FT +6k and FV2 +6k on the official view; FV-INEL W1.0 (INEL labels). April: same methods on April's own cells

title: S7c-INEL
body: +60 stage-3 trees fitted on INEL cells (date-parity gate)

title: Gap models
body: specialist, gap U-Net, weights refit by date cross-fit, edge taper

title: Physics is scored on our Task 1 rows
body: S_phys = S_FD/3 + 2 S_LWR/3 on the submitted speed and flow; no rows of its own, so every state piece is also a physics piece; pieces were ranked with .88 x (.35 dState + .45 dPhys)

title: Q03 site classifier
body: LightGBM on online precursors, fitted on train months

title: Q0436 switches
body: two calibrated online switches and an agreement rule on the window's own history

title: Onset decode
body: cell set with the highest expected IoU; top-two union if the probability ratio is ≥ .8

title: Ongoing members
body: 1-D CNN and sccnn (type A), 5 seeds each, 16 epochs; ConvNeXt- Tiny at .2 (ImageNet- 1k init)

title: Per-date adaptation
body: fine-tune on pseudo windows of earlier dates (5 ep, lr 6e-4); .75 adapted + .25 unadapted

title: Cold dates
body: ≤ 2 earlier dates: XSD two-stage pool with a speed term (A3); Tiny member adapted per date (A1)

title: Ongoing decode
body: expected-IoU top-k over 6 steps; persistence cap .92; type A raised to ≥ .8

title: Q-ACCUM
body: three per-date member deltas summed; 11 cells

title: ODME: the organiser's NNLS
body: min ||A f - c||² + .05 ||f - b||², f ≥ 0, on the split's own link counts c and prior b; every move away from this projection lost on the board
